t: If you had happened to be in Huck's place, you would have run off from there as if the devil were after you, and out of sheer fright you wouldn't have let on a word to anyone about the bandits and the rescue of Mrs. Douglas.

t: According to the custom of the time, all the children present—and there were several of them—were seated at small tables along the wall, in the same room.

t: When the proper moment came, Mr. Jones made a speech in which he thanked the widow for the honor she had shown him and his sons, but—he went on—there is someone else here whose modesty…

t: He made a masterful exit with his dramatic revelation about Huck's part in the adventure, but the guests' astonishment was strongly feigned and did not manifest itself in a way as loud and lively as it would have under other circumstances.

o: Pani domu jednak bardzo zręcznie udała zdziwienie i zasypała Hucka taką ilością komplementów i objawów wdzięczności, że biedak zapomniał nawet o tym, jak okropnie czuje się w swoim nowym ubraniu.
t: The lady of the house, however, very deftly simulated surprise and showered Huck with such a quantity of compliments and expressions of gratitude that the poor fellow forgot even how awfully he felt in his new clothes.

o: Wydawało mu się, że jest tarczą, w którą mierzy uwaga wszystkich gości, ich życzliwe spojrzenia i chóralne pochwały.
t: It seemed to him that he was a target on which the attention of all the guests was focused, their friendly glances and their unanimous praise.

o: Wdowa oświadczyła, że zamierza przyjąć Hucka do swego domu i wziąć go na wychowanie, a później, o ile jej środki na to pozwolą, pomóc mu skromnie, ale przyzwoicie urządzić się w życiu.
t: The widow declared that she intended to take Huck into her house and have him raised, and later, if her means allowed, to help him modestly but decently make his way in life.

o: — Huckowi tego nie potrzeba — wszedł jej w słowo Tomek.
t: "Huck doesn't need that," Tom interrupted her.

o: — Huck jest bogaty.

t: Only because of their good breeding did the guests not burst out laughing at this fine witticism.

t: "Half of it's Huck's, and half is mine."

t: The story was long, but it was as good to listen to as any thriller.

o: — Myślałem, że dziś wieczór zadziwię państwa moją niespodzianką, ale wobec tego, co tu widzę, przyznaję, że była ona bardzo mizerna…
t: "I thought I would astonish you all tonight with a little surprise, but seeing what I see here, I admit it was a very poor one..."

t: There was more than twelve thousand dollars of it.

o: Nikt z obecnych w salonie gości nigdy nie widział tylu pieniędzy naraz, chociaż byli wśród nich i tacy, których majątek przedstawiał większą wartość.
t: None of the guests gathered in the parlor had ever seen so much money at once, though among them were people whose fortunes were worth more.
